scripts.dev:platform: concurrently "cd platform && npm run dev" "node scripts/warm-platform.mjs"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:template"
scripts.install:api: cd api && py -3.11 -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd platform && npm install && cd ../store-template && npm install && cd .. && npm run install:api
